home.f1_d: Take a leaf photo; the AI model identifies 38 crop disease/health classes in seconds.
home.f2_d: 7-day disease risk for each farm from weather, crop stage, variety, soil and local history.
home.f3_d: Log pheromone/sticky-trap counts or connect IoT devices; alerts when the economic threshold is crossed.
home.f4_d: Confirmed cases are clustered on a map so officials see outbreaks early and nearby farmers are warned.
home.f5_d: Extension officers confirm or correct each AI diagnosis; confirmed cases retrain the model.
home.f6_d: IPM advice in English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Marathi — with read-aloud for easy use.
home.how1: Register your farm with location, crop, variety, sowing date and soil details.
home.how2: Get daily weather-based risk alerts for diseases and pests on your farm.
home.how3: Photograph a sick leaf — get an instant diagnosis and IPM advisory.
home.how4: An extension officer verifies the diagnosis; difficult cases are referred to a lab.
home.how5: Report progress at follow-up; outbreaks appear on the officials' dashboard and map.
home.subtitle: Photo-based AI diagnosis, weather-based risk forecasts, pest-trap monitoring, outbreak maps and expert-verified advice in your language.

model.learning_d: Every image an expert confirms or corrects is stored as a labelled example. Retraining fine-tunes the classifier on these examples (weighted ×5) plus the original data; the new version is activated only if accuracy on the held-out test set does not drop.
model.sub: MobileNetV2 transfer-learning model trained on the PlantVillage dataset, improved with expert-confirmed field images.

officer.sub: Reports are sorted by priority: notifiable diseases, not-improving cases, lab referrals and low AI confidence first.
